values.subject: ANDT-APP-0625 | Galaxy S22 Ultra third-party device appraisal report
values.body_text: Report ANDT-APP-0625 confirms serial SGS-22U-3724 and inspection ID INS-ANDT-3724G match the submitted device. Screen, frame, and camera condition are materially better than the recycler's initial assessment. Platform full trade-in value is CNY 4,300; the recycler settlement offer is CNY 2,100. Retain inspection video, condition photos, and purchase receipt and continue the platform review.
